hooks.text: Jupiter creates the largest structure in the Solar System.
Jupiter's magnetic tail reaches all the way to Saturn.
One invisible Jovian bubble stretches all the way to Saturn.

title: Jupiter's Invisible Magnetic Monster
description: Jupiter's magnetic field forms an invisible bubble so vast its tail reaches Saturn's orbit. Powered by metallic hydrogen and volcanic moons, it unleashes permanent auroras 100 times stronger than Earth's.
